evidence.extractor_note: Read files at pinned commit, not the modified live upstream worktree. Port pure logic without provider construction or Aer execution.
evidence.paper_count_limit: 44 gate counts+num_qubits+depth+five structural metrics=51 before train-only pruning; this does not recover the paper's36-field subset.

count_GATE.rule: For each44 named fields, float(qc.count_ops().get(GATE,0)), exact name, no aliases. Missing gate means count0. measure/barrier/reset/delay/unlisted operations have no slots but are explicitly audited.

depth.rule: qc.depth() with historical Qiskit default treatment of measure/barrier

global_definitions.structural_base: Exclude barrier and measure. Remaining operation count=G; allocated quantum wires=n. D=maximum operation path length through consecutive-touch quantum wire dependencies. Reset/delay, if present, remain operations. Dynamic control unsupported.

program_communication.rule: 2*distinct_unordered_qubit_pairs_coincident_in_any_operation/(n*(n-1)); every pair of a multi-qubit operation contributes;0 if n<2

critical_depth.rule: Depth of the >1-qubit-only quantum dependency DAG divided by the number of >1-qubit operations;0 if none

liveness.rule: sum quantum arities/(n*D);0 if n=0 or D=0

global_definitions.degenerate_case_policy: Zero denominators yield explicit0 and are logged. Reject nonfinite or metric outside[0,1] beyond1e-8; no structural bug clipping. Multi-qubit communication fixes the pinned helper's first-two-qubits limitation; disclose this adaptation.

compiled_two_qubit_operation_count.rule: Instructions with exactly2 quantum arguments, excluding barrier/measure

compiled_definitions.compiled_metrics: Five corresponding structural definitions evaluated on compiled_qc.
compiled_definitions.basis_evidence: Historical Sherbrooke basis=rz/sx/x/ecr; no invented native id. Preflight validates basis/context and logs extra reset/measure/delay.

graph_encoding.nodes: Every qc.data instruction in insertion order, including measure/barrier/reset/delay; no input/output wire nodes. Idle allocated wires have zero mask positions and remain width metadata.
graph_encoding.edges: For every quantum/classical wire touched, directed(previous_touch,node) then update previous_touch. Deduplicate ordered pairs. Measurement touches both arguments; barrier touches listed qubits. No reverse edges/self loops/edge attributes.
graph_encoding.gate_vocabulary: Sorted source+compiled training operation names, reserved __UNKNOWN__ index0; union from training hashes only, common encoding for controlled variants. Fit inner-train during epoch selection, outer-train at refit. Unknown held-out operations map to0 and are audited.
graph_encoding.wire_indexing: qc.find_bit(bit).index across all registers, index<127. Preserve physical compiled indices; do not compact idle wires.
graph_encoding.parameters: Up to4 finite real params in operation.params order; zero-pad absent entries with mask0, present mask1; no modulo angle reduction. Symbolic/non-real/array/>4 params unavailable. Delay duration unit must match fixed context, otherwise unavailable.
graph_encoding.normalization: 0/1 categorical/wire/presence masks; real params/pi; fixed arity/order divisions. No fitted node normalization. Globals StandardScaler fits training only.
graph_encoding.calibration: No node T1/T2/errors/durations. Fixed target/noise are provenance, not invented source-to-physical calibration mapping.
graph_encoding.unsupported: Empty graph, dynamic if_else/while/for/switch or legacy condition, invalid wire index/parameter; explicit terminal status, no flattened branch or fabricated node.

validation: Exactly51 unique ordered globals and13 unique compiled fields
Hybrid first51/source graph equal source variant
Compiled globals and graph evaluated on the same replay circuit
Finite globals, metric range and degenerate cases audited
Edges in range and acyclic, source index<target index
Historical replay/context and summary check before fit
